what_it_allows: Everything USER_ADMIN does across the company, plus company settings, creating User Admins and other owners, approving sensitive access grants; final approver when nobody else exists. The last owner cannot be removed.

what_it_allows: Add, edit, deactivate users; assign job roles and extra access; reset passwords, within their scope. Gives no access to business data. Creating another User Admin needs owner approval.
Own shifts, attendance, leave, swaps, notifications, own pay rate (view)
Views the roster of the place it is given and the events of its outlet; reads the recipes and prep procedures of the store linked to their department (no costs)
Views roster and attendance of their department; reads the recipes and procedures of their department's store

Builds and publishes the department roster; resolves attendance exceptions; first approval of leave and swaps; views the outlet's events; reads the recipes, prices and costs of their department's store

meant_for: Cooks and bartenders who make prep items

Creates and edits events for the whole outlet: covers, items and staff needed
Views stock, records counts and wastage, requests transfers, for that store only; reads the recipes and procedures made or sold at that store; records production batches of prep items made there

Everything STOCK_USER does, plus raises and receives purchase orders and dispatches internal transfers; reads recipes made or sold at the store (no prices or costs); records production; told when sales take stock below zero

Views stock, counts, wastage and purchase orders across all stores of the outlet (no stock changes); recipes, prices, cost per serve and cost % of the outlet; posts daily sales; variance and food and beverage cost %
Maintains worker records and leave for the outlet

what_it_allows: Views everything in the area, including linked stores (read-only); approves large purchase orders and escalations; menu costs across the area (view only)
Manages stock at the central kitchen store and dispatches transfers to outlets (that store only); recipes and costs of what the central kitchen makes; records production at the central kitchen
Views stock in every store below the place it is given (no changes)
Worker records, pay rates, leave across the company
